title: D'Andre Swift, Kyle Monangai good to go for Bears

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: D'Andre Swift, Kyle Monangai good to go for Bears
sources.description: The Bears had their top two running backs on the injury report this week, but neither one of them is at risk of missing Sunday's game against the Vikings.
